as_told.title: Rumored 2004 dogfight between Lockheed and JSOC crash retrieval teams

plain: A story goes around about two teams who showed up at the same crash site and fought over it. A podcast host named Jack, speaking on an episode of Jesse Michels' show, says a private military contractor working for the defense company Lockheed Martin was sent to recover a crashed craft. He says a team from JSOC, the US military's Joint Special Operations Command, which runs elite special forces units, was sent to the same site. Michels himself repeats it later as a rumor of a firefight between a Lockheed retrieval team and a JSOC retrieval team. He dates it to 2004 and places it at Coyame, in Mexico. He ties it to a man named Jake Barber and a project called Sentinels of Ether. They tell it because, if true, rival government and private groups are competing, even with gunfire, to recover crashed craft.
